glosses: Affectionate or sentimental in an effusive, tearful, or foolish manner, especially because of drunkenness.

examples.text: Why, man, you couldn't stand—you made everybody laugh in the Gardens, though you were crying yourself. You were maudlin, Jos. Don't you remember singing a song?

...you are my devoted friend too. You do more and work harder and oh shit I'd get maudlin about how damned swell you are. My god I'd like to see you... You're a hell of a good guy.

glosses: Extravagantly or excessively sentimental; mawkish, self-pitying.

examples.text: To cap it all I had written a letter to Mara saying that we had to find a way out soon or I would commit suicide. It must have been a maudlin letter because when she telephoned me she said it was imperative to see me immediately.
